title: Archives
description: Pack files into one, squeeze them smaller, and unpack them again (tar and zip).

exercises.task: Create two empty files in it: photos/a.jpg and photos/b.jpg.
exercises.hint: touch takes several names at once: touch <file> <file>

exercises.task: Pack the photos folder into one compressed file called photos.tar.gz.
exercises.hint: tar -czf <archive> <folder>: c = create, z = compress with gzip, f = the file name comes next.

exercises.task: List what's inside photos.tar.gz without unpacking it.
exercises.hint: Swap c for t (think 'table of contents'): tar -tzf <archive>

exercises.task: Unpack photos.tar.gz into the restored folder.
exercises.hint: x = extract, and -C says where to put things: tar -xzf <archive> -C <folder>

exercises.task: Now the other common kind: pack the photos folder into photos.zip.
exercises.hint: zip needs -r to include what's inside a folder: zip -r <archive> <folder>

exercises.task: List what's inside photos.zip without unpacking it.
Unpack photos.zip into a new folder called unzipped.
exercises.hint: -d says where to put things (the folder is made for you): unzip <archive> -d <folder>

done: You just packed, listed and unpacked with tar (-czf, -tzf, -xzf -C) and with zip and unzip.
